mechanism_narrative: A quarterly increase in GDPC1, indicating strengthening economic demand, boosts consumer and business confidence, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in > 50% of quarters with positive GDPC1 growth, or quarterly GDPC1 growth fails to correlate with subsequent SPX returns (Pearson r < 0.2).

mechanism_narrative: When FEDFUNDS exceeds 4.5%, signaling a tightening monetary cycle, investors anticipate reduced borrowing capacity, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS > 4.5%, or the signal's Rank IC remains below 0.05 over any 1-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Jointly, when UNRATE falls below 4% and PAYEMS growth accelerates (> 200k new jobs), the strengthening labor market boosts economic growth expectations, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward analysis shows the joint condition fails to predict positive 5d returns in > 55% of instances, or the interaction's partial correlation with SPX returns is insignificant (p > 0.1).

mechanism_narrative: An increase in INDPRO, indicating improved industrial production, enhances economic efficiency, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days, but only during non-recessionary periods.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 50% of non-recessionary periods with positive INDPRO growth, or the signal's out-of-sample Rank IC falls below 0.04.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly increase in HOUST, signaling strengthening housing demand, precedes broader economic growth, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward analysis shows the signal's hit rate for positive 60d returns is < 52%, or the correlation between HOUST growth and subsequent SPX returns is insignificant (p > 0.15).

mechanism_narrative: When CPIAUCSL growth exceeds 3% YoY, indicating rising inflation expectations, and FEDFUNDS is below 3%, the mismatch in monetary policy and inflation signals negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint condition fails to predict negative 20d returns in > 58% of instances, or the interaction's partial correlation with SPX returns is insignificant (p > 0.12).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained UNRATE below 3.5% for 3 consecutive months, indicating a very tight labor market, leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days due to anticipated wage inflation.
failure_condition: Walk-forward analysis shows the signal's hit rate for negative 5d returns is < 50%, or the correlation between sustained low UNRATE and subsequent SPX returns is insignificant (p > 0.18).

mechanism_narrative: RSAFS growth exceeding $350 billion, signaling strong retail sales, boosts consumer confidence, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days, but only during holiday seasons.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 55% of holiday seasons with strong RSAFS growth, or the signal's out-of-sample Rank IC falls below 0.035.
